scripts.start:prod: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd services/api; if [ -f .env.prod ]; then set -a; source .env.prod; set +a; fi; ENABLE_E2E_SEED= NODE_ENV=production node dist/src/main.js'
scripts.tests: bash scripts/restart-api.sh && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s typecheck && NODE_ENV=test pnpm -s test
scripts.api:kill: bash -lc 'PORT=${API_PORT:-3000}; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; echo killed:$pids; else echo none; fi'
scripts.tests:up: bash scripts/restart-api.sh && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s typecheck && pnpm -s test
scripts.api:ps: bash -lc 'PORT=${API_PORT:-3000}; lsof -nP -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN || echo "API not listening on $PORT"'
scripts.api:prod: pnpm -s api:kill && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s start:prod
scripts.prod:stop: bash -lc 'pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:${API_PORT:-3000} -sTCP:LISTEN || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids; echo stopped:$pids; else echo none; fi'
scripts.start:prod:safe: [ -n "$JWT_SECRET" ] || (echo "❌ JWT_SECRET required" && exit 1); NODE_ENV=production node dist/src/main.js
scripts.smoke:prod: pnpm -s prod:stop; pnpm -s prod:up; curl -sS http://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/api/health | jq .; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/api/test/seed/admin-web || true
